name: Red World Fan Fork
summary:
What if the Soviets Won?

Red World imagines a modern scenario in which the Soviet Union won its cold war against the United States. Despite becoming our globe's sole superpower, the Soviets face the daunting task of maintaining ultimate control.
It seems that in the coming years everything might just be slipping away...

In memory of Kaiser1871, the original creator of Red World and a dear friend to us all. This fan fork will continue to expand and update Red World along Kaiser's intended plans and wishes, making it a fun experience for everyone to enjoy once again to its fullest!
